offer.say: Your ice at six o'clock is like a cutting board. I do not say this to be unkind. I say it because it is true and you are the one with the thermostat.

options.text: The plant's already eating me alive. Not this month.

why.say: Minus three, minus three and a half at the surface. Soft enough to bite, firm enough to land. Hockey wants a parking lot. We are not hockey.

options.text: I'll warm it for your mornings.
Can't hockey and figure both be happy?
Let me think about the power bill.

both.say: At the same hour? No. At different hours, yes, if someone plans the day properly. That someone is you. Gus did it with a pencil.

options.text: Then I'll plan it. Your mornings are soft.

both_gus.say: Gus left you many things. Most of them are good. Will you warm my ice or not?

cheek.say: I save 'agricultural' for your edges, {owner}. Do not make me use it on the ice as well.

decline.say: Then this month we skate carefully. Next month I ask again. I am very patient. It is my worst quality.

accepted.say: Bon. I will know on the first stroke. I always know.

progress.say: You are here about my ice.

options.text: Anything else before I call it done?

p_warm.say: Still hard. The little ones are falling on their waltz jumps and blaming their mothers. Set it warmer before we come and colder after we go.

p_hold.say: Better. Once is luck. Three times is a rink.

p_edge.say: The corners. There is a ridge by the visitors' gate that catches a toe pick. Earl calls it 'character'. I call it a ridge.

complete.say: Three mornings. The little ones landed their waltz jumps and did not know why it was easier. I knew. Here. This was on my first carnival costume, 1975. It should be somewhere warm and seen.

options.text: It'll go in the trophy case beside the little white skate.

c_case.say: Yes. Beside the skate. That skate was Marie-Claude's. She is a grandmother now and still cannot do a loop.

c_keep.say: No. I am giving it. Taking it back is rude. Accept it or I will be cross with you in French.

c_smile.say: It was a nod. Do not spread rumours. The parents will expect it every week.

done.say: The ice is good. Do not let it go to your head.
